summary: Defender XDR runs on Unified RBAC alone with Microsoft Sentinel optional, Defender assignments no longer fail on Microsoft's redirect, and the coverage report follows your commits.

fixes.title: Microsoft Sentinel is optional for Defender XDR
fixes.text: Defender XDR is ready when Unified RBAC answers and its workloads are active. Only a role that uses Data Operations permissions waits for Sentinel, as a calm note on that row.

fixes.title: No manual confirmation for Defender
fixes.text: PIM Manager recognises from your live Defender roles that Unified RBAC is in use and, when a role already uses Data Operations, that Sentinel is connected. Nothing needs to be pressed.

fixes.title: Defender assignments with Microsoft's redirect
fixes.text: Microsoft answers a new Defender XDR role assignment with a redirect. PIM Manager now reads the assignment back instead of reporting the run as failed.

fixes.title: Coverage follows your commits
fixes.text: After a commit that changed something, the tenant cache and the coverage report are refreshed within minutes, and the Overview says how old the coverage report is.
